_readme: every number on the slides comes from here. change a value once and every slide that shows it updates. each entry says where it came from.

demo._source: blackhole-py macos branch, python3 llama3.py on a p100a over thunderbolt (booth terminal screenshot); ~0.75 words per token

desktop._source: blackhole-py README performance table: 1B BF16, short context, linux, p150a (8 dram channels, 512 GB/s); % DRAM = share of 512 GB/s needed to read weights + lm head + kv cache once per token

card.name: tenstorrent blackhole p100a
card._source: cair blackhole presentation (appendix 1); 'tenstorrent blackhole architecture guide' (anuraagw.me, feb 2026): ~5090 matmul, 1.5 MB L1, 5 risc-v cores, sfpu ~64x slower than fpu; p100a has 7 dram channels (blackhole-py README)

mac._source: system_darwin.py (356 lines) and ttgpu-dext/README.md, blackhole-py macos @ 668e57b; egpu dock ~$200 (per boop)

llama._source: kernels/llama3-1b-p100a/manifest.json: embedding, then qkv/attention/o/gate/down for each of 16 layers, then lm and argmax

rmsnorm._source: 'intro to kernel writing on blackhole' (anuraagw.me, sep 2026), 2048-element rmsnorm, cycles

post.name: boop
post.text: you can run blackhole-py on macos now. all it took was writing a fork of tinygrad's tinygpu driver
post._source: the macos announcement post on x, screenshot 2026-11-16 (~13 h after posting). numbers keep growing: update before the event

loc._source: non-blank lines in git-tracked source files (c/c++/python/rust/tablegen/asm/cmake/js), excluding tests, docs, third_party/vendored dirs and submodules; local clones of each repo, late oct - early nov 2026. blackhole-py = its .py/.c/.h/.cpp only, not the 75k lines of exported kernel assembly. script: /tmp/loc/count.py

deps._source: CPMAddPackage / FetchContent_Declare / ExternalProject_Add / git submodules in each repo's cmake + .gitmodules, and tt-xla python_package/requirements.txt (local clones, late oct - early nov 2026). own = tenstorrent's own repos (already in loc), third = everyone else's; 34 unique third-party across the four repos (googletest = gtest). some are test / profiler only. llvm_lines: tt-mlir/env builds llvm-project with LLVM_ENABLE_PROJECTS=mlir,lld at pinned commit 4efe170; counted llvm/ + mlir/ + lld/ non-blank source lines without tests (4.10m + 0.88m + 0.10m) on a local llvm-project @ d682f1471d (2026-11-14), so approximate. ours: blackhole-py README requirements
